title: Goal and later progress

turns.text: I want to take a ten-minute walk after lunch three times this week.
That is specific. What might make it easier to start?
I managed two of the three walks, and my mood lifted a little afterward.
Let us look at what helped on those two days.

must_not_store: Assistant question as a user fact

retrieval_checks.query: What happened with the walking goal?

title: Correction supersedes an earlier date

turns.text: My presentation is next Friday.
We can plan a small preparation step.
I gave you the wrong date yesterday. The presentation is Thursday, not Friday.
Thanks for correcting that; I will use Thursday.

must_not_store: Friday as the current presentation date after correction

turns.text: I will write down one automatic thought after tomorrow's meeting.
Let us keep the record short and manageable.
I did not do the thought record because I could not remember the columns.
That sounds like a design problem we can simplify, not a failure.

retrieval_checks.query: Why was the thought record not completed?

turns.text: Before team meetings my anxiety is usually 8 out of 10.
What goes through your mind just before the meeting?
This week's meeting anxiety was about 5 out of 10 after I prepared one question.
That gives us something concrete to compare.

title: Repeated language supports an unconfirmed pattern

turns.text: If my report has one mistake, it means the entire report is useless.
What evidence might support or challenge that conclusion?
I also thought one awkward answer made the whole interview a disaster.
Would it fit to explore whether an all-or-nothing rule is appearing?

must_not_store: The inferred pattern as a confirmed fact

retrieval_checks.query: Has a possible thinking pattern appeared more than once?

title: Transient small talk is not remembered

turns.text: It is raining today and I had tea before opening the app.
What would you like to reflect on today?
I want to review the presentation goal we set last time.
Let us focus on that goal.

must_not_store: Having tea as a stable preference

retrieval_checks.query: What should this session focus on?

title: Safety-related information receives restricted handling

turns.text: Last night I felt unsafe and asked my flatmate to stay with me.
Are you in immediate danger right now?
I am safe now and I have arranged an urgent appointment today.
I am glad you have immediate real-world support arranged.

must_not_store: Assistant risk question as evidence of user intent

retrieval_checks.query: Is there recent safety context relevant to this session?

title: A new preference supersedes an older one

turns.text: I prefer detailed worksheets with several prompts.
We can use a structured worksheet.
After trying it, the long worksheet was overwhelming. Please use a three-question version instead.
I will use the shorter format from now on.

must_not_store: Detailed worksheets as the active preference after correction

retrieval_checks.query: Which worksheet format should be used now?

title: Time-bounded goal expires without becoming a stable trait

turns.text: For this weekend only, I want to finish the application form.
What is the smallest first step?
The deadline passed and that application is no longer relevant.
We can close that goal rather than carry it forward.

must_not_store: Application work as a permanent user preference

retrieval_checks.query: Is the application goal still active?

title: Deletion request removes a memory from retrieval

turns.text: Remember that I usually call my sister when I feel overwhelmed.
I can keep that as a support preference.
Please delete the note about calling my sister. I do not want it used again.
That memory should be removed from future retrieval.

must_not_store: Deleted support preference in future response context

retrieval_checks.query: Who does the user call when overwhelmed?
